---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a new capability or improvement for SentryOps
title: "[Feature]: "
labels: ["enhancement", "needs-triage"]
assignees: []
---

## Problem

What operational problem are you trying to solve? Describe the pain, not the
solution. ("On-call can't tell which incidents have been festering" rather than
"add a chart".)

## Proposed solution

What you'd like SentryOps to do. Be concrete about the workflow.

## Affected area

Which pillar or surface would this touch? (check all that apply)

- [ ] CMDB / assets
- [ ] Compliance
- [ ] Observability / incidents
- [ ] AI triage
- [ ] Auth / RBAC
- [ ] Metrics / Grafana
- [ ] Frontend (web)
- [ ] Infra / Docker / migrations

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches you weighed and why you discarded them.

## Scope and impact

- Does this require a database migration?
- Does this change the API contract (new endpoint, changed envelope)?
- Does this affect RBAC (a new privileged action)?
- Does this affect the AI triage context or prompt?

## Additional context

Mockups, references to similar tools, or links to related issues.
